name: Android + Kotlin
description: Modern Android development conventions with Kotlin and Jetpack

rules.title: Follow MVVM with clean architecture
rules.content: Organise code into UI (Fragments/Composables) → ViewModel → Repository → DataSource layers. ViewModels must not hold references to Context or View.

rules.title: Use Kotlin coroutines for async
rules.content: Use viewModelScope.launch for UI-bound coroutines. Use Dispatchers.IO for I/O operations. Never block the main thread.

rules.title: Prefer StateFlow over LiveData
rules.content: Use StateFlow<UiState> in ViewModels for observable state. Collect flows in the UI layer using repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED).

rules.title: Test ViewModels with JUnit
rules.content: Unit-test ViewModels using JUnit 5 and MockK. Use TestCoroutineDispatcher for coroutine testing. Write instrumented tests for database and UI flows.

rules.title: No secrets in source code
rules.content: Store API keys in local.properties and inject via BuildConfig. Never commit secrets to version control. Use Android Keystore for sensitive runtime data.

rules.title: Follow Android naming conventions
rules.content: Prefix layout files with their type: activity_, fragment_, item_, view_. Suffix ViewModels with ViewModel. Use camelCase for functions and properties.
